comment: Riyadh is the heart of the Kingdom. The blend of history in Diriyah with the modern towers is amazing.
The city vibes during Riyadh Season are world-class. There is always something new to discover every day.
The mix of traditional heritage and luxury dining is impressive. The organization of events is top-notch.
A vibrant capital with great energy! I loved the winter activities, though the city is very large for walking.
